name: tokens

test_list.description: Every colour role of the PLAN token table is present with exactly the table's hex value.
Role names are unique kebab-case and every hex is #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
The error role carries the ANSI fallback Red; roles without a stated fallback carry none.
css_variables() emits one --p-<role>: <hex>; declaration per role, plus radius, speed and font variables.
The output is a single :root { ... } block ending in a newline.
Blending the source colour at 30% over the background reproduces every selection tint listed in the PLAN table (#464646, #4B4435, #233800, #29364B, #6C6C6C).
Rgb::from_hex rejects missing '#', wrong length and non-hex digits.
The empty-editor placeholder text is exactly "What's on your mind for Polaris?".
Any Rgb survives to_hex then from_hex unchanged.

output_description: Colour roles as data, a :root CSS variable block and the 30% selection blend.
